title.zh: 美国OCC发布《GENIUS Act》首个最终规则
title.en: US OCC issues first final rule implementing the GENIUS Act

current_state.zh: OCC 敲定了实施 GENIUS 法案关于稳定币储备与赎回的规则，财政部长斯科特·贝森特将此比作林肯时代 1863 年的《国家货币法》，并称其为美国金融的转折点。
current_state.en: The OCC finalized rules implementing the GENIUS Act on stablecoin reserves and redemptions, a step Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent likened to the Lincoln-era National Currency Act of 1863 and called a watershed moment for American finance.

updates.title_zh: 【美国 OCC 发布《GENIUS Act》首个最终规则，不预设现有稳定币奖励计划合规】
updates.title_en: 【美国 OCC 发布《GENIUS Act》首个最终规则，不预设现有稳定币奖励计划合规】
updates.what_changed_zh: 美国 OCC 发布了实施 GENIUS 法案的最终规则——这是联邦银行监管机构的首个此类最终规则——为受监管机构和外国公司自 2027 年 1 月 18 日起发行和托管稳定币建立框架，同时拒绝推定现有稳定币奖励计划合规，也不为其提供安全港，对禁止“仅”因持有或使用稳定币而支付奖励的规定采取逐案解读，并以基于原则的监管取代拟议的可反驳推定和规定性储备多元化限制。
updates.what_changed_en: The U.S. OCC issued its final rule implementing the GENIUS Act — the first such final rule from a federal banking regulator — establishing the framework for regulated and foreign firms to issue and custody stablecoins from January 18, 2027, while refusing to presume existing stablecoin rewards programs are compliant or to offer them a safe harbor, applying a case-by-case reading of the ban on rewards paid 'solely' for holding or using a stablecoin, and replacing proposed rebuttable presumptions and prescriptive reserve diversification limits with principles-based supervision.

updates.title_zh: OCC 在 1 月截止日期前敲定 GENIUS 法案稳定币规则
updates.title_en: OCC Finalizes GENIUS Act Stablecoin Rules Ahead of January Deadline
updates.what_changed_zh: 最终规则进一步明确：将《银行保密法》、反洗钱与制裁要求排除在外，留待与财政部联合制定规则；OCC 将另行宣布何时开始接受稳定币发行商申请和豁免请求，并明确规则覆盖储备、赎回、风险管理、托管、资本及州合格发行商过渡等。
updates.what_changed_en: The final rule further clarifies that Bank Secrecy Act, AML and sanctions requirements are excluded and will be handled in a separate joint rulemaking with Treasury; the OCC will separately announce when it begins accepting issuer applications and waiver requests, and the rule covers reserves, redemption, risk management, custody, capital and state-qualified issuer transitions.
updates.current_state_zh: OCC 已发布实施《GENIUS Act》的最终规则，为受其管辖的支付稳定币发行商设定储备、赎回、风险管理、托管和资本等要求，规则将在 2027 年 1 月 18 日法律生效时适用；反洗钱与制裁规则留待与财政部联合制定，申请与豁免受理时间将另行公布。
updates.current_state_en: The OCC has issued its final rule implementing the GENIUS Act, setting reserve, redemption, risk-management, custody and capital requirements for payment stablecoin issuers under its jurisdiction when the law takes effect on January 18, 2027; AML and sanctions rules are deferred to a joint rulemaking with Treasury, and the timing for accepting applications and waivers will be announced separately.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: The OCC issued its final rule implementing the GENIUS Act, establishing reserve, redemption, risk-management, custody and capital requirements for payment stablecoin issuers under its jurisdiction before the law takes effect on January 18, 2027, while deferring AML and sanctions standards to a joint rulemaking with Treasury.
updates.detailed_summary_en: The OCC issued its final rule implementing the GENIUS Act, establishing reserve, redemption, risk-management, custody and capital requirements for payment stablecoin issuers under its jurisdiction before the law takes effect on January 18, 2027, while deferring AML and sanctions standards to a joint rulemaking with Treasury.
